name: Injoku Studio ~Haitoku no Misshitsu Audition~
original_name: 淫辱スタジオ～背徳の密室オーディション
source:
Shunsuke was a promising scenario writer. But, his future was destroyed by Yukari, who was a voice actress. He makes a living as a scenario writer of adult video games now. One day, he meets a rookie voice actress, Maya, in the recording studio. "....!?" He is so surprised to see the face of her personal manager.... It's Yukari.... His revenge has just begun....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090108030629/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1007244]ErogeShop[/url]].
translation:
俊介曾是一名很有前途的剧本作家，未来却被声优由香里毁掉。如今，他靠为成人游戏撰写剧本维持生计。一天，他在录音棚遇见新人声优真耶。‘…！？’看到她的经纪人时，他震惊不已…那个人正是由香里…他的复仇就此开始…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090108030629/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1007244]ErogeShop[/url]]。
